 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE DIVYESH A. JOSHI  Date : 13/03/2024
ORAL ORDER 1. Rule.
Learned APP waives service of notice of rule for respondent - State of Gujarat.

2. The present application is filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, for regular bail in connection with the FIR being C.R. No.11217041230159/2023 registered with the Saraswati Police Station, Patan for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 465, 467, 468, 471,
409, 120(B) and 201 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Learned advocate for the applicant submitted that the so-called incident has taken place for the period between 01.01.2019 to 23.06.2021, for which, the FIR has been lodged on 15.04.2023 and the applicant has been arrested in connection with the same on 02.07.2023 and since then, he is in judicial custody.

Learned advocate submitted that NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/22603/2023 ORDER DATED: 13/03/2024 undefined now the investigation is completed and after submission of the chargesheet, the present application is preferred.

Learned advocate submitted that there is Rabari (Desai) Dashrathbhai Jorabhai vs State Of Gujarat on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43827781/

sentences.text: inordinate and unexplained delay caused in filing aforesaid FIR.
Learned advocate submitted that FIR has been filed against total 15 accused persons, wherein the applicant is shown as accused no.5.

Learned advocate submitted that it is alleged in the FIR against the applicant that the applicant - accused in connivance with other accused persons, has forged the documents like revenue record of the persons, who have already died as well as who are the memebrs of the society and presented those forged documents as it genuine one and on the strength of those forged and fabricated documents, applications for loan have been submitted and huge amount of loan has been received and the said amount has been misappropriated by the accused persons in connivance with each other.
Learned advocate submitted that the co-accused, who is having identical role and/or grave role than the present applicant, has been considered by this Court.
Learned advocate submitted that all the offences are exclusively triable by the Court of Magistrate.

Learned advocate submitted that entire case of the prosecution hinges upon documentary evidence, which have been collected by the IO during the course of investigation and number of witnesses have been cited in the chargesheet and, NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/22603/2023 ORDER DATED: 13/03/2024 undefined hence,
trial would get delayed.

Learned advocate, under the instructions, submitted that without prejudice to his rights and contentions, the applicant is ready and willing to deposit Rs.13,00,000/- before the concerned trial court, out of which, the applicant will deposit Rs.5,00,000/- within five days from the date of his release and remaining amount of Rs.8,00,000/- will be deposited in four equal installments within four months thereafter i.e. in the month of April to July, 2024 and in support of it, the son of the applicant has filed an undertaking-cum- affidavit narrating above facts and after the release, the applicant will also file such undertaking.
It is, therefore, urged that considering the nature of the offence and on the ground of parity, the applicant may be enlarged on regular bail by imposing suitable conditions.
4. Learned APP, Mr. Dabhi for the respondent-State as well learned advocate, Mr. Vyas for original complainant have opposed grant of regular bail looking to the nature and gravity of the offence.
It is submitted that the role of the present applicant is clearly spelt out from the papers of the chargesheet.

Learned APP submitted that in connivance with each other, the accused have committed alleged offences and thereby misappropriated huge volume of amount and the involvement of the present applicant is found out from the chargesheet papers.

Learned APP,
NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/22603/2023 ORDER DATED: 13/03/2024 undefined therefore,
urged that considering the gravity and seriousness of the offence the present application may not be entertained.
5. Learned advocates appearing on behalf of the respective parties do not press for further reasoned order.

6. I have heard the learned advocates appearing on behalf of the respective parties and perused the papers of the investigation and considered the allegations levelled against the applicant and the role played by the applicant.
It is found out from the record that the present application is preferred after submission of the chargesheet and now the investigation is completed and the applicant is in jail since 02.07.2023.
All the offences are exclusively triable by the Court of Magistrate.

The case of the prosecution hinges upon documentary evidence, which have been collected by the IO during the course of investigation and number of witnesses have been cited as witness in the chargesheet Rabari (Desai) Dashrathbhai Jorabhai vs State Of Gujarat on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43827781/

Therefore considering NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/22603/2023 ORDER DATED: 13/03/2024 undefined the above factual aspects and on the ground of parity, the present application deserves to be allowed.
